featured_reviews.name: vips kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
A small & cozy ambient dine-in set up. Neat, clean & all tidy. The servers need to be helpful while we try & ask them about the menu. In our case, it didn't happen. He just read stuffs from the menu.
Coming to the food part:
▪️ They don't provide regular drinking water, only packaged drinking water (chargeable at MRP)
▪️ We had ordered a juice & pasta, both of which were really good at taste, & delivered kind-of quickly.
For the billing part, since they are two different subsidiaries with a common seeting, you need to pay separately for both the restaurants. We ended up paying for the juice at Health (something), & for the Pasta at Say Cheese. That's add to inconvenience.

Overall a great experience & do visit. Try Pink Sauce Pasta.

featured_reviews.review_text: This outlet is located at hindmata facing roadside. They have limited seating. featured_reviews.name: Nitika Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been visiting Health juice center located at Matunga King Circle for almost 15years now . Their strawberry milkshake is the ultimate Best I have ever tasted & they have been consistently serving the same taste for so many years which is highly commendable .

When I came to know that Health juice centre is opened in Parel I had to visit it .
I had to meet someone for urgent discussion & was in the same vicinity hence decided to visit the Parel outlet .

The most interesting aspect of this joint is that everything served here is made from scratch fresh in front of you .

They have a wide range of delectable juices , shakes & sandwiches to choose from .
The rates are pocket friendly & the serving quantity is generous & filling for 1 person .
The service is really quick so you dont have to wait too long .They also have home delivery option in the vicinity if you wish to enjoy the hot sandwitches & chilled drinks watching netflix with your friends or family .

I always order the strawberry juice , strawberry malai & strawberry milkshake as they use frozen stawberries instead of artificial syrups & flavours which imparts real sweet tangy taste .

This is the main reason I am a patent customer of Health juice for so many years as it is impossible to find this level of quality in any other restaurant in Mumbai !

The vada pav & samosa grill cheese sandwitch is my top favourite as it is generously overloaded with vegetables served piing hot with chutneys & crisp potato chips .

This outlet also serves the famous street chaats of Mumbai which was exceptionally well made .The paani puri is a must try .

Do visit health juice centre if you are looking for healthy yet tasty food in the real sense of the term .

featured_reviews.review_text: This place is really nice to go in the evenings or at night after dinner! They have such amazing mikshakes, juice as well as sandwiches!! The one that I would recommend is "Blaster"

featured_reviews.name: Vighnaraj Narvekar
featured_reviews.review_text: A vintage lassi spot that serves as a taxi location icon when at dadar, near the railway station. Primarily for the thick punjabi lassi, they've now added on with plenty of options in their pantry with choices like mango and dryfruit. Common breakfast items like Vadapav and patties are also served. Overall, it's an average spot considering the tastes and not really value for your money. Could be skipped...

featured_reviews.name: Vaish_studio
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kailash Mandir is one of the most popular lassi spots near Dadar station and has a strong local following. It's known for its thick and creamy lassi eaten with a spoon rather than chugging it with many flavour options available. They provide quick service despite the heavy crowds and has limited seating. We ordered the Mango lassi , kesar masala lassi and kaju badam pista lassi . Quantity was proportionate to the price. But the taste wasnt out of this world as everyone had been raving about . Snacks are freshly prepared like every other corner of Mumbai - Vada pav , samosa pav , pav bhaji , mirchi vada , dahi samosa , dahi kachori , dahi vada .
Overall a good place for morning quick breakfast or evening snacks .

featured_reviews.name: Nirmal Wasnik
featured_reviews.review_text: Best Lassi in Dadar till date I have experienced. Tried kesar Malai lassi. Awesome taste😋😋. Location is easily accessible, just to Dadar station east @Dada Saheb Phalke marg. You can also enjoy their Wada pav... A must visit place if you are Lassi lover.

featured_reviews.name: Merlin
featured_reviews.review_text: Kailash Mandir Lassi, located near Dadar railway station, is a well-known spot famous for its thick and refreshing lassi. It's perfect for a quick stop if you’re exploring Dadar and need something cool and satisfying. The prices are reasonable, making it a great budget-friendly option. Please note, the place is not wheelchair accessible.

featured_reviews.name: Rajat Bajaj
featured_reviews.review_text:
After my peaceful visit to the Dadar Gurudwara on the auspicious occasion of Gurupurab, I stopped at Kailash Mandir Shop, located right underneath Dadar Railway Station, to enjoy a glass of their famous Mithi Lassi with Malai. Being from Delhi, I have a special fondness for thick, creamy lassi, and this one surely brought back nostalgic memories. They served it generously topped with extra malai — slightly on the sweeter side, but still refreshing and chilled to perfection. While I must say that Delhi and Punjab still hold the crown when it comes to authentic lassi, this one was a good attempt and worth trying at least once.

I also tried their Vada Pav, which turned out to be quite tasty and freshly made. The prices were reasonable, and the service was quick, making it a convenient stop for a quick snack after a spiritual visit or a train journey.

Overall a simple yet satisfying Mumbai-style experience — soulful Gurbani at the Gurudwara followed by a sweet, malai-rich lassi break at Kailash Mandir Shop.

featured_reviews.name: Tejas Lone
featured_reviews.review_text:
Fantastic Spot for Fresh Juices and Healthy Drinks!
Think Juice in Parel is an absolute gem for anyone who enjoys fresh, healthy beverages. Every time I visit, I’m impressed by the quality of the juices, smoothies, and detox blends they offer. The ingredients are always fresh, and you can taste the difference – nothing artificial or watered down, just pure goodness.

Their Cold Pressed Juices are a must-try, especially the Green Detox and Citrus Cleanse. I also love the smoothies – the Berry Blast and Mango Mania are personal favorites. They strike the perfect balance between taste and nutrition. What’s great is that they also offer sugar-free options, which is ideal for health-conscious folks.

The staff is courteous, knowledgeable, and quick with recommendations if you're not sure what to try. The store itself is clean, well-organized, and has a welcoming vibe. You can tell they take pride in both their products and service.

Whether you're grabbing a quick post-gym drink or just looking to cool off on a hot day, Think Juice delivers every time. Highly recommended for anyone looking to make healthier choices without compromising on taste. Definitely a five-star experience every time I go!

featured_reviews.review_text:
I tried Think Juice’s fresh mango shake recently. The first time, it was honestly really good – it tasted like a proper mango shake, fresh and flavourful. That’s why I decided to order it again.
But the second time, it was disappointing. The mango didn’t taste fresh, and the shake felt more like plain milk with very little mango. I even visited the store and mentioned it, and ordered again, hoping it would be better—but it still tasted the same, more milk than mango.
Not sure about the consistency, but I hope they improve the quality because the first experience was actually great.

Honestly, ₹170 for a mango shake here doesn’t feel worth it. The quality is not consistent, and for this price, you expect a rich, real mango taste—but it feels more like a basic milkshake with very little mango.

Definitely overpriced for what they’re serving right now.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Mumbai Central Snacks and Juice Centre is one of those convenient little spots right near Mumbai Central railway station and close to the bridge at Nathani Heights.

There are two shops. The one I usually go to is the one at the right of the building and near the entry point of the internal building parking.

It's mainly a takeaway kind of place, especially since there’s no real seating unless you’re okay just standing outside and eating. But for what it is, it works well.

I’ve tried their veg club grill here multiple times and that’s something I’d recommend as it's good and quote filling.

The fruit juices are fresh as well, and overall the menu covers a decent range of quick bites like burgers, pizza, pav bhaji, etc. It’s all pure vegetarian, which is worth keeping in mind.

Another plus is that it stays open quite late, which makes it a reliable option if you’re around the area at night and looking for something quick.

Pricing is reasonable, portions are fair, and service is generally quick and efficient which is basically what you’d expect from a place like this.

Not somewhere you’d go to sit and relax, but for a quick bite or takeaway near Mumbai Central, it does the job well.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Haji Ali Juice Centre after visiting Haji Ali Dargah as we wanted to have some fresh juice. Even though I was having cold and cough, I still wanted to try something here. We noticed many varieties of cream puddings displayed, which looked very tempting. Since it was our first time, we asked the staff which one was the best, and they suggested the Seetha Phal (custard apple) cream pudding, so we ordered that along with rose milk falooda.
As they said, the Seetha Phal cream pudding was extraordinary and super in taste, very rich and satisfying. The rose milk falooda was good, but not as special as the pudding. They also serve many other juices, desserts, and snacks.
Prices are definitely on the higher side, and most items feel expensive. The ambience is simple and nothing fancy, and the service is just okay. Overall, the Seetha Phal cream pudding is highly recommended if you visit here.

featured_reviews.name: Sakib Mulla
featured_reviews.review_text:
A perennial favorite among locals and tourists alike, Haji Ali Juice Centre is an iconic culinary landmark nestled at the threshold of the historic Haji Ali Dargah. Since its inception in the 1960s, this bustling establishment has cultivated a legendary status, evolving from a modest stop for pilgrims into a vibrant gastronomic institution. It is celebrated for its unwavering commitment to quality, utilizing fresh, seasonal ingredients to craft an extensive repertoire of refreshments that have become synonymous with Mumbai's street food culture.
Reviewers frequently highlight the establishment's ability to maintain high standards of hygiene and flavor despite the immense daily crowds. The atmosphere is quintessentially Mumbai—a high-energy, casual setting where patrons often enjoy their treats standing on the pavement or from the comfort of their cars, adding a unique drive-in charm to the experience.
• Signature Fruit Creams: The "Sitaphal" (custard apple) cream is universally acclaimed as a must-try masterpiece, featuring a luscious, thick consistency generously laden with fresh fruit chunks.
• Exotic Shakes & Juices: Guests often praise the Mango Milkshake for its rich, creamy texture and the "Triveni"—a sophisticated blend of mango, strawberry, and kiwi juices.
• Savoury Accompaniments: Beyond beverages, the menu boasts popular fusion snacks like the Jain Pizza and the indulgent Cheese Toast, noted for its generous cheese-to-bread ratio.
• Late-Night Accessibility: Operating from the early morning until well past midnight, it serves as a reliable sanctuary for night revelers seeking high-quality refreshments.

featured_reviews.review_text: The Haji Ali Juice centre is such an iconic eatery in Mumbai. It's a must visit if you are visiting Mumbai for the first time for sure. They have some of the most delicious shakes and ice creams. But my favourite is the strawberry cream. It's absolutely delicious. Having ice cream late at night near the sea is such a fun experience.

featured_reviews.name: Sanoop ks
featured_reviews.review_text:
Haji Ali Juice Centre is one of those places in Mumbai that almost everyone has heard about, and naturally, expectations are quite high before visiting. The menu is extensive, filled with a wide variety of juices, shakes, and desserts that look appealing at first glance. The taste of the items is definitely good—fresh, flavorful, and satisfying to an extent. You can tell that the ingredients are of decent quality and prepared well.

However, beyond that initial impression, nothing truly stands out. There isn’t anything particularly unique or memorable about the flavors that would make you want to come back again and again. It feels like what you get is something you could easily find at many other juice shops across the city.

One of the biggest drawbacks is how overhyped the place feels. Because of its popularity and constant crowd, you go in expecting something exceptional, but the experience turns out to be fairly average. This mismatch between expectation and reality is quite noticeable.

On top of that, the pricing feels a bit on the higher side for what is offered. While the quality is decent, it doesn’t quite justify the cost, making it seem overrated.

Overall, Haji Ali Juice Centre delivers good taste but nothing extraordinary. It’s worth trying once for the experience, but it may not live up to the hype surrounding it.
